description.value: Realm Food Co is a locally-focused eatery in Parksville, BC, built around seasonal, farm-sourced ingredients and a strong commitment to supporting Vancouver Island growers. The menu is broad and accommodating, spanning tacos, ramen, sandwiches, and substantial salads with clear GF, vegan, and dairy-free labelling throughout. Takeout and catering are available, and the kitchen cooks fresh to order, making it a solid meal stop for cyclists with varied dietary needs.

address.value: Unit 2 - 180 Craig Street, Parksville, BC V9P 2G8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is the primary evidence source: the footer explicitly states 'CATERING. TAKE OUT. NO RESERVATIONS.' confirming takeout; the menu pages use consistent GF/V/DF/NF tags throughout and the about page states 'From vegan to paleo and everything in-between,' confirming dietary accommodation. No mention of bike racks, water refill, or washrooms appears on the website or in OSM tags, so those are left null. OSM hours conflict significantly with website hours, which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Hours discrepancy: OSM lists Mo-Sa 11:00-20:00 and Su 09:30-13:30,16:00-20:00, but the website states TUESDAY-SATURDAY 9:30AM-6:00PM with SUNDAY & MONDAY CLOSED. OSM hours appear significantly out of date.
Phone (250-586-1158) and address (Unit 2 - 180 Craig Street, Parksville, BC V9P 2G8) sourced from website only; OSM record has no contact fields to cross-check against.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established Parksville restaurant with confirmed takeout service, extensive dietary accommodations (vegan, GF, DF), and locally-sourced food — a useful and cyclist-friendly meal stop on Vancouver Island.
